page.notes: Small printed bullet marks (») at the start of lines were left out as typographic marks, not words. "valis[?]": the first word is uncertain; the scan reads "ualis". "Prolperi" is printed so. "promerem:" is read from the scan and may be misprinted. The italic setting is judged from the scan, and "Si" in the Augustine quotation is roman.
